Sam promised to water the seed while his sister was away.
A lost puppy followed the sound of a familiar little bell.
Two mice disagreed about how to share the last piece of bread.
After the snow melted, Eva found her missing mitten near the shed.

scope_limitations: No model inference, training, download, service, GPU, Git or remote mutation.
The frozen panel and all existing source/data/report bytes remain untouched.
A negative exact/defined-near audit does not establish global contamination absence, semantic novelty or train/validation paraphrase separation.
Exact prefix overlap does not establish full-story identity or model memorization.
Publication openings are original authored items; lack of equality with development strings is not proof of zero human/agent development exposure.
Raw/prepared file identities and reconstruction bind the actual historical corpus, but cannot independently certify its upstream generative provenance or privacy.
This resolves a bounded audit subgate only, not DXI-03's trained comparison or DXI-17/18.
